title: Matched 65k low-temperature on-policy learning-curve pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The positive2/3-anchor T0.5 smoke direction will persist over a longer matched horizon, with a stronger cross-anchor point estimate than T1 while maintaining source-KL and optimizer health.
material_change: Fresh untouched Standard10 starts for matched T1 and T0.5 arms; identical corrected-v6 adaptive three-policy league, source KL0.1, seeds, fixed deal stream, sampled hero, optimizer, single-rollout topology, and65,536 physical-hand target. Only hero behavior/PPO temperature differs. Archive every4 updates; after both finish, evaluate frozen archives/endpoints on a new untouched common-deck seed. No Slumbot during this pilot.
baseline: T0.5 bounded smoke: pooled +3.5179 bb/100, CI[-17.2532,24.2890],2/3 positive anchors over3,072 common-deck pairs; T1 control and two argmax-local alternatives were nonpositive.
source: Untouched Standard10 SHA91b0... for both fresh arms; current default-off temperature implementation and corrected-v6 trainer.

notes: Scale gate is internal only. The stronger Standard10 greedy contract motivates T0.5, but historical T1 sampled weakness is not assumed monotonic. Fresh arms avoid resume/ephemeral-state ambiguity.
17 pre-run tests passed. Starting fresh T1 control first; target65536 physical hands, archive every4 updates.
T1 control completed14 updates at65657 physical hands, final ref KL0.0037, no KL stop; iter4/8/12 archives retained. Starting fresh matched T0.5 treatment.

Treatment crossed target at iter15/71239 physical while control crossed at iter14/65657. Boundary-match recovery: resume control same run/optimizer/counters/adaptive provenance/deal stream for exactly one additional PPO boundary to target70000; frozen pre-recovery control iter14 and treatment iter15 copies retained.

First boundary-recovery launch was interrupted before any PPO update because stdout exposed default reset_optimizer=true. Latest checkpoint remained byte-identical iter14 SHA15d9...,14 metrics unchanged; assignment row15 is a pending provenance record. Relaunching with optimizer preservation and pending-assignment reuse.

Both fixed-pool session audits PASS at matched iteration-15 endpoints: control 71,353 physical/61,850 transition hands; treatment 71,239 physical/61,854 transition hands. Control recovery preserved optimizer and reused pending assignment after an interrupted pre-update attempt.
Endpoint gate failed without Slumbot: pooled T0.5-minus-T1 -0.422648 bb/100, paired 95% CI [-19.301541,18.456244], despite 2/3 positive anchors. Standard10 delta -27.073975 CI [-52.689087,-1.458862].

result.summary: Matched iteration-15 T1 and T0.5 arms completed 142,592 physical environment hands and 49,152 untouched multi-anchor evaluation hands with fully audited raw paired evidence.
result.conclusion: T0.5 did not retain its smoke advantage at 65k scale: pooled treatment-control was -0.422648 bb/100 with paired 95% CI [-19.301541,18.456244]. The Standard10 anchor was significantly worse (-27.073975, CI [-52.689087,-1.458862]), while the other two anchors were positive but individually inconclusive.
result.next_step: Return to the evidence-ranked learned-policy program. Treat execution temperature alone as exhausted; prioritize a training objective or league curriculum that explicitly preserves Standard10 greedy competence while improving broader anchors, and require a matched internal gate before any Slumbot spend.
